== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Life''' was recommended by team coach [[oDin (Ju Yeong-dal)|oDin]].
* Reached 3000 assists in the LCK on April 2nd, 2023.
** Was the 11th player to reach 3000 assists in the LCK after [[GorillA]], [[Wolf (Lee Jae-wan) | Wolf]], [[Score]], [[Faker]], [[TusiN]], [[Deft]], [[Peanut]], [[Lehends]], [[Bdd]], and [[Keria]].
* Reached 500 games in the LCK on May 21, 2025, becoming the 20th player to do so.
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2023)
